Name: lluviann's Heart Hand Mirror For FashionSense
Author: lluviann
Description:
This mod is a simple reskin for FashionSenses' Mirror!
To Install:
 - After downloading Fashion Sense, you can replace the HandMirror.png file in - FashionSense/Framework/Assets/HandMirror.png
 - Paste my HandMirror.png from the assets file into FashionSense/Framework/Assets/HandMirror.png
 - Replace the png with mine and confirm!
